description: Base graph node. Carries the GTS instance envelope (id, type) plus the producer-authored fields; tenant, timestamps, actor and revision are gear-assigned and are deliberately not part of the type.

scope_managed.description: Whether rows of this type participate in producer-scoped replacement re-sync.

emit_events.description: Whether CREATE/UPDATE/DELETE events are published for this type.

index.description: Payload paths backed by a JSONB index and admissible in $filter.

full_text_search.description: Paths composed into the node tsvector.

vector_search.description: Paths composed into the embedding input.

id.description: Producer-supplied stable key, unique per tenant. The ingest DTO spells it node_key; it is the GTS instance id.

tenant_id.description: Tenant that owns the element. Server-assigned from the security context on write; present on read and on export so an instance is self-describing outside its request.

deleted_at.description: Soft-delete tombstone; absent or null on live elements. Server-assigned (Soft Delete Contract).

payload.description: Typed attributes; derived types refine this member.

content.description: Long-form text; chunked and indexed, bounded by content_max_bytes.
